title: DFP CC termination (Rp) requirements
text_helper: Table 5. DFP CC termination (Rp) requirements — section 4.2 Power capability detection and usage

headers: Rp pull up to 4.75 V - 5.5 V
notes: 1. For Rp when implemented in the USB Type-C plug on a USB Type-C to USB 3.1 Standard-A Cable Assembly, a USB Type-C to USB 2.0 Standard-A Cable Assembly, a USB Type-C to USB 2.0 Micro-B Receptacle Adapter Assembly or a USB Type-C captive cable connected to a USB host, a value of 56 kΩ ± 5% shall be used, in order to provide tolerance to IR drop on VBUS and GND in the cable assembly.
